text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You want to play card games with me?
Sorry, but
I ain't really got time for
babysittin' damsels.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, oh come now. That won't be the
case!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In the name of training my spirit even
further, I
simply want to compete with
one of the
academy's most competitive
spirits!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Geez. Well you've got a good eye, I'll
give you
that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And El? Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I mean, I was just passin' by at first!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't help myself after hearin' about
a fresh
new competition. The world's
strongest has no
choice but to compete
with the best!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All these Uma are so pushy these days.
Never
know when to pipe down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to do this, then go to the
store and
bring back some hard candies.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we'll use them instead of chips
today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and make sure to get the minty
ones. I can't
stand anything too sweet.
